description: Record a time an employee cannot work (one-off, or recurring with an RFC 5545-style rule such as FREQ WEEKLY, INTERVAL 1, BYDAY MO). Auto-scheduling then skips them. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/unavail.

comment.description: Note the manager sees. Default empty.

end_time.description: Unavailability end: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

start_time.description: Unavailability start: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 datetime (include an offset for local times).

name: deputy_add_unavailability
title: Add unavailability for an employee
